title: Sharp Gaussian Mixed-Norm Theory for Fock Spaces
summary: We develop a structural theory of the Gaussian mixed-norm Fock spaces $\mathcal F_α^{p,q}$, where $α>0$ and $0<p,q\leq\infty$, which separate angular $L^p$-means from radial Gaussian $L^q$-summability. We first prove the sharp circle-mean estimate $M_p(f,r)\leq C_{α,q}(1+r)^{-\frac{1}{q}} e^{\fracα{2}r^2}\lVert f\rVert_{\mathcal F_α^{p,q}}$, $r\geq0$, where $M_p(f,r)$ denotes the angular $L^p$-mean of $f$ on the circle $\lvert z\rvert=r$ with the convention $\frac{1}{\infty}=0$, and show that the exponent $-\frac{1}{q}$ is optimal.
